_note: Discovery + ranking config. Copy to jobhunt/config.json and edit. ATS board slugs are checked at runtime: a wrong slug just returns 0 jobs. Replace every example list with your own targets.

companies._note: Board slugs from the public ATS URLs: boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>. These are examples of public boards, not recommendations.

scoring._note: Points added per role bucket. Raise the buckets you want most. Buckets: founding, ai, fullstack, backend, swe.

geo_rules._note: Edit for your country. 'home' terms count as fully eligible. Set gulf_eligible true if you would relocate there.

hn_whoishiring._note: Algolia HN Search API: finds the latest 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' story and pulls its top-level comments.

yc_jobs._note: Public ycombinator.com/jobs pages embed the listings as JSON in a data-page attribute. Apply links go through a login on workatastartup.com, so you apply there yourself.

post_harvest._note: LinkedIn hiring-post harvester via the Apify actor harvestapi/linkedin-post-search (cookieless, no LinkedIn login, about $0.05 per run). Set APIFY_TOKEN or create jobhunt/.apify_token (gitignored).
query_templates: hiring full stack developer startup india
hiring new grad software engineer india
hiring founding engineer early stage startup
post_harvest._query_note: Write these like LinkedIn search-bar queries: role + location + seniority + 'hiring'. Replace with the roles you target. Fewer, sharper queries beat many vague ones.
post_harvest._browser_note: max_scroll_rounds and pacing are only used by the optional Threads browser path (threads_posts.py).

telegram._note: Optional Telegram job-channel harvester. Reads as you via a Telethon user session (you must be a member of the channel). One-time interactive login creates session_file, which is gitignored. Never commit it.
telegram._ignore_note: Self-promo or paid-referral links that are not real applications. A post whose only link matches one of these counts as having no apply link.
